title: Return window
text: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging. Start a return from your order page or ask the assistant with your order number.

title: How long refunds take
text: Refunds go back to the original payment method. Card refunds usually appear within 5 to 10 working days after we approve them. Refunds over 100 pounds are checked by a member of the team first, which can add one working day.

title: Delivery times
text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days in the UK. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 working days. You get a tracking number by email when your order ships.

title: Delivery cost
text: Standard delivery is free on orders over 40 pounds, otherwise it costs 3.99 pounds. Express delivery costs 7.99 pounds.

title: Cancelling an order
text: You can cancel an order until it ships. Once it has shipped, wait for delivery and start a return instead.

title: Damaged or faulty items
text: If an item arrives damaged or faulty, tell us within 14 days of delivery with a photo. We refund or replace it and pay for the return postage.

title: Items that cannot be returned
text: Gift cards, personalised items, underwear and opened software cannot be returned unless faulty.

title: Payment methods
text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay. We never ask for your full card number in chat.

title: Changing your email address
text: Change your email address in Account settings. For security the assistant cannot change account details for you.

title: Talking to a person
text: Ask the assistant for a human at any time. Our team works 8am to 8pm, seven days a week, and replies within 2 hours.
